title: Assistant
intro: Ask about a game, a series or a genre, or ask for a recommendation. Games the assistant mentions open in the app.

suggestions.similar: Recommend games like the ones I rated 9 or 10.
suggestions.backlog: From my backlog, which one should I start with?
suggestions.short: Suggest short games, under 10 hours, that I’d enjoy.
suggestions.hidden: Which lesser-known games fit my taste?

placeholder: Type your question… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line)

errors.generic: The assistant couldn’t answer. Try again.
errors.network: The connection to the server dropped mid-answer. Try again.
errors.settings: Could not read the assistant settings. Reload the page.

side.privacy: With each question, the chat and your shelf (games, statuses, hours, ratings and your notes) go to Anthropic with your key. The chat stays in this tab only.

settings.title: Assistant (Claude)
settings.description: Each person uses their own Anthropic key, billed to their account. The key is tested before it’s saved, stays encrypted on the server and never comes back to the browser.
settings.keyKept: Saved, ends in {{hint}}. Leave blank to keep it.
settings.modelHint: Pick a suggested one or load the list of models your key can use.
